entries.meaningZh: 帕萨迪纳〔美国加州城市〕
entries.en: The parcel from Pasadena arrived with a handwritten note tucked inside.
entries.zh: 那个从帕萨迪纳寄来的包裹到了，里面夹着一张手写便条。

entries.en: The researcher compared two Vedic passages without attempting a new translation.
entries.zh: 研究者比较了两段吠陀文本，没有尝试另作翻译。

entries.meaningZh: 莫洛托夫〔彼尔姆的历史名称〕
entries.en: The old travel diary described a long wait at the station in Molotov.
entries.zh: 那本旧旅行日记描述了在莫洛托夫车站长时间等候的经历。

entries.en: A Frenchwoman at the next table lent us a pencil for the crossword.
entries.zh: 邻桌的一位法国女士借给我们一支铅笔做填字游戏。

entries.en: The visitor waited while a Trappist finished putting the books back on their shelf.
entries.zh: 来访者等着一位特拉普派修士把那些书放回书架。

entries.en: Mrs. Wodehouse collected the empty cups before opening the curtains.
entries.zh: 沃德豪斯太太先收走空杯子，再拉开窗帘。

entries.en: The sketch of the Euphrates was too wide to fit on the album page.
entries.zh: 那幅幼发拉底河的速写太宽，放不进相册的那一页。

entries.meaningZh: 登徒子；玩弄感情的男人
entries.en: She soon discovered that the charming stranger was a selfish Lothario.
entries.zh: 她很快发现，那个迷人的陌生人是个自私的登徒子。

entries.en: The linguist revised the section on Algonquian before sending the manuscript to her editor.
entries.zh: 那位语言学家修改了阿尔冈琴语系那一节，然后才把书稿交给编辑。

entries.en: The student used photographs of Incan objects to plan the exhibition's opening display.
entries.zh: 那个学生利用印加文化物品的照片，设计展览开头的陈列。

entries.en: His Delphic reply left us wondering whether he had accepted the invitation.
entries.zh: 他那含糊难解的答复，让我们不知道他是否接受了邀请。

entries.en: Our cousin sent a drawing from Toulon instead of the usual postcard.
entries.zh: 我们的堂表亲从土伦寄来一幅画，而不是平常寄的明信片。

entries.en: Mr. Houdini left his gardening gloves on the kitchen windowsill.
entries.zh: 霍迪尼先生把园艺手套放在了厨房窗台上。

entries.en: A Guinean artist helped us arrange the drawings for the student exhibition.
entries.zh: 一位几内亚艺术家帮助我们摆放学生展览的画作。

entries.en: The Liverpudlian beside me offered to watch my suitcase while I bought tea.
entries.zh: 我身旁的那位利物浦人主动提出，在我买茶时帮我看着行李箱。

entries.en: The missing umbrella belonged to Mrs. Haywood, not the delivery driver.
entries.zh: 那把不见的雨伞属于海伍德太太，不是送货司机的。

entries.en: We discussed Honoré de Balzac after reading the introduction to a newly translated novel.
entries.zh: 读完一本新译小说的导言后，我们讨论了巴尔扎克。

entries.en: Her essay on Tacitus needed a clearer distinction between the two translations.
entries.zh: 她那篇关于塔西佗的文章，需要更清楚地区分两个译本。

entries.en: Steinberg stayed behind to help stack the chairs after the meeting.
entries.zh: 会议结束后，斯坦伯格留下来帮忙叠椅子。

entries.meaningZh: 动物磁力；假想的自然力〔旧说〕
entries.en: The author attributed the character's visions to od, a supposed natural force.
entries.zh: 作者把那个人物的幻象归因于动物磁力，即一种假想的自然力。

entries.en: The photographs from Murmansk were still in their original paper envelope.
entries.zh: 那些来自摩尔曼斯克的照片，还装在原来的纸信封里。

entries.en: She unfolded a drawing of the River Boyne on the library table.
entries.zh: 她在图书馆的桌子上展开了一幅博因河的画。

entries.en: He looked forward to returning to Blighty and sleeping in his own bed.
entries.zh: 他盼着回到英国本土，睡在自己的床上。

entries.en: Geraint found his notebook beneath a pile of clean towels.
entries.zh: 杰伦特在一叠干净毛巾下面找到了笔记本。

entries.en: The lecturer compared the Mendelian model with another account in the textbook.
entries.zh: 讲师把孟德尔学说的模型与教材中的另一种解释进行了比较。

entries.en: The host brought out a bottle of Malaga after the plates had been cleared.
entries.zh: 盘子收走后，主人拿出了一瓶马拉加葡萄酒。

entries.en: Mrs. Rossetti kept the spare keys in a blue bowl beside the door.
entries.zh: 罗塞蒂太太把备用钥匙放在门边的蓝色碗里。

entries.en: The class compared two translations of Pushkin before choosing a passage to discuss.
entries.zh: 全班先比较了普希金作品的两个译本，再选取一段进行讨论。

entries.en: The artist left space for Judah in the unfinished biblical illustration.
entries.zh: 画家在那幅尚未完成的经文故事插画里给犹大留了位置。

entries.en: The suitcase from Honolulu contained more sketchbooks than clothes.
entries.zh: 那个来自火奴鲁鲁的行李箱里，速写本比衣服还多。

entries.en: Hathaway brought a thermos of tea for the volunteers setting up the hall.
entries.zh: 海瑟薇给正在布置礼堂的志愿者们带来了一保温瓶茶。

entries.meaningZh: 卡律布迪斯〔希腊神话对象〕
entries.en: The stage designer made a paper model of Charybdis for the school play.
entries.zh: 舞台设计师为学校的戏剧制作了一个卡律布迪斯的纸模型。

entries.en: The museum guide paused beside a display of Hittite objects.
entries.zh: 博物馆导游在一处陈列赫梯物品的展台旁停了下来。

entries.en: Her report outlined the Pavlovian account before considering the objections to it.
entries.zh: 她的报告先概述了巴甫洛夫理论的解释，再讨论针对它的异议。

entries.en: The old Zairean magazine had a handwritten shopping list between its pages.
entries.zh: 那本扎伊尔旧杂志的书页之间夹着一张手写购物清单。

entries.en: Redding offered to carry the folding table back to the storeroom.
entries.zh: 雷丁主动提出把折叠桌搬回储藏室。

entries.en: A letter from Montevideo was waiting beneath the stack of newspapers.
entries.zh: 一封从蒙得维的亚寄来的信，正放在那叠报纸下面。

entries.en: Mr. Galsworthy put a small lamp beside the armchair for his guest.
entries.zh: 高尔斯华绥先生在扶手椅旁放了一盏小灯，供客人使用。

entries.en: Mrs. Coppola returned the ladder before the neighbours began painting their fence.
entries.zh: 邻居开始刷围栏之前，科波拉太太把梯子还了回去。

entries.en: The actor playing Agamemnon practised his entrance while the stage lights were adjusted.
entries.zh: 扮演阿伽门农的演员练习登场时，舞台灯光正在调整。

entries.en: Scorsese checked the classroom windows before leaving the building.
entries.zh: 斯科塞斯离开大楼前，检查了教室的窗户。

entries.en: The historian compared two Manichean texts in a seminar on religious literature.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家在宗教文学研讨课上比较了两篇摩尼教文本。

entries.en: The old notebook contained a sketch of a street in Antioch.
entries.zh: 那本旧笔记本里有一幅安提俄克街道的速写。

entries.en: A pierrot in a loose white costume waited beside the travelling theatre's horse-drawn wagon.
entries.zh: 一名穿着宽松白色戏服的白面丑角，等在巡回剧团的马车旁。

entries.en: The postcards we sent from Eindhoven arrived after we had already returned home.
entries.zh: 我们从埃因霍温寄出的明信片，在我们回家之后才送达。

entries.en: She kept the letters from Lapland in a tin beneath her desk.
entries.zh: 她把那些从拉普兰寄来的信，存放在书桌下面的铁盒里。

entries.en: Mr. Isherwood borrowed a watering can and returned it before lunch.
entries.zh: 伊舍伍德先生借了一个浇水壶，午饭前便还了回来。

entries.en: Mrs. Parnell brought extra cushions for the wooden chairs in the hall.
entries.zh: 帕内尔太太给礼堂里的木椅子带来了一些额外的坐垫。

entries.en: Mr. Mitford found a folded shopping bag in his coat pocket.
entries.zh: 米特福德先生在外套口袋里找到一个折好的购物袋。

entries.en: Tandy volunteered to wash the cups after the afternoon discussion.
entries.zh: 下午的讨论结束后，坦迪主动提出洗杯子。

entries.en: The researcher compared two biographies of Al Capone before drafting her introduction.
entries.zh: 研究者在起草导言之前，比较了两本阿尔·卡蓬的传记。

entries.en: The Cameroonian photographer asked us to move the chairs away from the window.
entries.zh: 那位喀麦隆摄影师请我们把椅子从窗边移开。

entries.en: Groucho placed the spare blankets on the highest shelf in the cupboard.
entries.zh: 格劳乔把备用毯子放在橱柜最上层的架子上。

entries.meaningZh: 英国人〔美式或旧式口语〕
entries.en: The Britisher sharing our compartment offered us biscuits from his travel bag.
entries.zh: 和我们同坐一间车厢的那位英国人，主动提出请我们吃他旅行包里的饼干。

entries.en: A Shan at the workshop helped the children mount their drawings on coloured paper.
entries.zh: 工作坊里的一位掸族人帮助孩子们把画裱在彩纸上。

entries.meaningZh: 亨利·詹姆斯作品风格的
entries.en: She discussed the Jamesian style of the dialogue without comparing the authors' lives.
entries.zh: 她讨论了那些对话所呈现的亨利·詹姆斯式风格，没有比较作者们的生平。

entries.en: Our photographs of Ferrara were mixed up with the drawings from another trip.
entries.zh: 我们的菲拉拉照片，与另一次旅行的画作混在了一起。

entries.en: We discussed Duke Ellington after listening to an old radio interview.
entries.zh: 听完一段旧广播采访后，我们讨论了杜克·埃林顿。

entries.en: Swanson remembered to bring a torch but forgot the spare batteries.
entries.zh: 斯汪森记得带手电筒，却忘了备用电池。

entries.en: Mrs. Inge waited beside the library doors with a bag of donated books.
entries.zh: 英奇太太带着一袋捐赠的书，在图书馆门旁等候。

entries.en: The editor asked for a clearer portrait of Canute for the illustrated biography.
entries.zh: 编辑要求为那本配插图的传记提供一张更清晰的卡纽特肖像。

entries.en: Lillie took the damp towels outside before returning to the kitchen.
entries.zh: 利利先把湿毛巾拿到外面，再回到厨房。

entries.en: The sketch of the Alhambra was pinned beside our other travel drawings.
entries.zh: 那幅Alhambra宫殿的速写，被钉在我们其他旅行画作的旁边。

entries.en: A child dressed as a Sasquatch waved from the back of the puppet theatre.
entries.zh: 一个装扮成北美野人的孩子，从木偶剧场后面挥手。

entries.en: Mr. Pliny returned the borrowed suitcase with a thank-you note inside.
entries.zh: 普林尼先生把借来的行李箱还了回来，里面放着一张感谢便条。

entries.en: Mrs. Humboldt moved the small table closer to the reading lamp.
entries.zh: 洪堡太太把那张小桌子移到了更靠近阅读灯的位置。

entries.en: The historian compared a Trotskyist's letter with other personal accounts in the archive.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家把一名托派支持者的信，与档案中的其他个人记述进行了比较。

entries.en: The illustrator tried several poses for Damocles before choosing one for the storybook.
entries.zh: 插画师先为达摩克利斯试画了几种姿势，再为故事书选定其中一种。

entries.en: Her notebook from Brescia had a loose cover and several unfinished drawings.
entries.zh: 她那本来自布雷西亚的笔记本，封皮松了，里面还有几幅未完成的画。

entries.en: The Omani designer brought fabric samples to the workshop in a wooden box.
entries.zh: 那位阿曼设计师把布料样品装在木盒里带到了工作坊。

entries.en: An Australasian journal accepted her essay after she revised the opening section.
entries.zh: 她修改了开头部分之后，一份澳大拉西亚期刊接受了她的文章。

entries.en: The seminar compared an Einsteinian model with an alternative mathematical description.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了一个爱因斯坦理论模型与另一种数学描述。

entries.en: The letter from Drogheda contained a small drawing of the sender's garden.
entries.zh: 那封从德罗赫达寄来的信里，有一幅寄信人花园的小画。

entries.en: A Genoese musician lent us a folding music stand for the afternoon rehearsal.
entries.zh: 一位热那亚音乐家借给我们一个折叠谱架，用于下午的排练。

entries.en: Keble repaired the torn paper cover before lending the notebook to his friend.
entries.zh: 基布尔修补了撕破的纸封皮，然后才把笔记本借给朋友。

entries.en: Gorky carried the heavy basket upstairs while the others cleared the table.
entries.zh: 其他人收拾桌子时，高尔基把沉重的篮子搬上了楼。

entries.en: The historian compared Britannic customs as described in two old travel accounts.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家比较了两份旧旅行记述中描写的英国习俗。

entries.en: The suitcase we brought from Kampala still smelled of the soap packed inside.
entries.zh: 我们从坎帕拉带来的行李箱，仍有装在里面的肥皂的气味。

entries.en: The student compared two portraits associated with the Lancastrian court.
entries.zh: 那个学生比较了两幅与兰开斯特王朝宫廷有关的肖像。

entries.en: The old Fuego in our family's garage needs a new seat cover.
entries.zh: 我们家车库里的那辆老富果车，需要一个新座套。

entries.en: Dvorak brought a spare sweater for the long evening journey.
entries.zh: 德沃夏克为漫长的夜间旅程带了一件备用毛衣。

entries.meaningZh: 萨斯喀彻温〔加拿大省名〕
entries.en: The old letters from Saskatchewan were tied together with green ribbon.
entries.zh: 那些从萨斯喀彻温寄来的旧信，用绿色缎带捆在一起。

entries.en: Rasmussen found the shopping list in yesterday's newspaper, not in his wallet.
entries.zh: 拉斯马森在昨天的报纸里找到了购物清单，而不是在钱包里。

entries.meaningZh: 普罗米修斯〔希腊神话人物〕
entries.en: The student made a clay figure of Prometheus for her imagined stage set.
entries.zh: 那个学生为自己构想的舞台布景，制作了一尊普罗米修斯泥像。

entries.en: Mr. Oppenheimer carried the empty flowerpots back into the shed.
entries.zh: 奥本海默先生把空花盆搬回了棚屋。

entries.en: The unfinished illustration showed Nimrod standing beside a tree in the artist's imagined scene.
entries.zh: 那幅尚未完成的插画中，宁录站在画家构想的场景里的一棵树旁。

entries.en: Her essay on Montaigne began with a comparison of two translations.
entries.zh: 她那篇关于蒙田的文章，以比较两个译本开篇。

entries.en: The researcher consulted an old printed interview with Bob Mathias before revising the profile.
entries.zh: 研究者修改人物介绍前，查阅了一篇对鲍勃·马赛厄斯的旧采访。

entries.en: The parcel from Krakow contained a scarf and a carefully wrapped drawing.
entries.zh: 那个从克拉科夫寄来的包裹里，有一条围巾和一幅仔细包好的画。

entries.en: The actress playing Juno checked her costume in the mirror beside the stage.
entries.zh: 扮演朱诺的女演员在舞台旁的镜子前检查戏服。

entries.en: A Chadian photographer showed the students how she arranged her exhibition prints.
entries.zh: 一位乍得摄影师向学生们展示她是怎样摆放展览照片的。

entries.en: The students compared Piagetian interpretations of the conversation in their reading group.
entries.zh: 学生们在读书小组中，比较了对那段对话的几种皮亚杰理论解释。

entries.en: The old map of the Jutland Peninsula was folded inside her travel notebook.
entries.zh: 那张日德兰半岛的旧地图，折好放在她的旅行笔记本里。

entries.meaningZh: 狄奥尼西奥斯〔古希腊统治者〕
entries.en: The class compared two historical accounts of Dionysius I of Syracuse.
entries.zh: 全班比较了两份关于叙拉古统治者狄奥尼西奥斯一世的历史记述。

entries.meaningZh: 美少年；俊美的年轻男子
entries.en: The novel's young Adonis was admired for his appearance but disliked for his vanity.
entries.zh: 小说中那位俊美的年轻男子因外貌受到欣赏，却因虚荣而不讨人喜欢。

entries.en: The photographs from Thuringia were packed in a box beneath the winter coats.
entries.zh: 那些来自图林根的照片，装在一个箱子里，放在冬季外套下面。

entries.en: She kept the drawings she made of Polynesia separate from the rest of the travel collection.
entries.zh: 她把自己画的波利尼西亚画作，与其余旅行藏品分开保存。

entries.en: Malthus brought extra paper for the children making decorations in the hall.
entries.zh: 马尔萨斯给在礼堂里制作装饰品的孩子们带来了额外的纸。

entries.en: The lecturer showed a portrait of Giotto before discussing the exhibition catalogue.
entries.zh: 讲师先展示了一张乔托的肖像，再讨论展览图录。

entries.en: Mrs. Spock put a fresh towel beside the guest's suitcase.
entries.zh: 斯波克太太在客人的行李箱旁放了一条干净毛巾。

entries.en: The historian compared two old Malayan travel accounts in the library.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家在图书馆比较了两份关于马来半岛的旧旅行记述。

entries.en: Mr. Diderot brought the borrowed bicycle back before the afternoon rain.
entries.zh: 狄德罗先生在下午下雨前，把借来的自行车还了回来。

entries.en: Streep helped us carry the empty boxes out of the meeting room.
entries.zh: 斯特里普帮助我们把空箱子搬出会议室。

entries.en: Mrs. Sitwell left a spare pair of slippers beside the bed.
entries.zh: 西特韦尔太太在床边放了一双备用拖鞋。

entries.en: The students discussed Abelard after reading the introduction to the translated text.
entries.zh: 读完那篇译文的导言后，学生们讨论了阿伯拉德。

entries.en: A small bowl stood ready for the maundy in the quiet church.
entries.zh: 安静的教堂里，一个小盆已经摆好，准备供洗足礼使用。

entries.en: The reviewer noticed a Churchillian tone in the fictional minister's speech.
entries.zh: 评论者注意到，那个虚构部长的演讲带有邱吉尔式的语气。

entries.en: The students sorted photographs of Paleozoic fossils before arranging the display boards.
entries.zh: 学生们先整理古生代化石的照片，再布置展板。

entries.en: The Gambian artist brought three small drawings to the workshop.
entries.zh: 那位冈比亚艺术家把三幅小画带到了工作坊。

entries.en: A Guyanese at our table offered to share her umbrella with us after the meeting.
entries.zh: 会议结束后，我们同桌的一位圭亚那人主动提出和我们共用她的雨伞。

entries.en: The seminar compared accounts of Maoism in several historical studies.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了几部历史研究中对毛泽东主义的论述。

entries.meaningZh: 符拉迪沃斯托克；海参崴
entries.en: The old travel diary contained a drawing of a doorway in Vladivostok.
entries.zh: 那本旧旅行日记里，有一幅海参崴一处门口的画。

entries.meaningZh: 犹太女性〔旧称，常有冒犯意味〕
entries.en: She rejected the insulting description of her as a Jewess.
entries.zh: 她拒绝接受别人用带有侮辱意味的“犹太女人”来称呼她。

entries.en: We discussed Algernon Charles Swinburne while choosing material for the poetry seminar.
entries.zh: 挑选诗歌研讨课材料时，我们讨论了阿尔杰农·查尔斯·斯温伯恩。

entries.en: Schulz left the spare batteries in a drawer beside the radio.
entries.zh: 舒尔茨把备用电池放在了收音机旁的抽屉里。

entries.en: The old album contained several photographs from Picardy and a pressed flower.
entries.zh: 那本旧相册里，有几张来自皮卡第的照片和一朵压干的花。

entries.en: Mr. Kellogg borrowed our wheelbarrow to move pots across his garden.
entries.zh: 凯洛格先生借了我们的手推车，用来把花盆搬到花园另一边。

entries.en: He left an IOU beside the empty biscuit tin and promised to repay us.
entries.zh: 他在空饼干盒旁留了一张借条，并答应还钱给我们。

entries.en: The architect's drawing showed a Tobin's tube ventilator beneath the classroom window.
entries.zh: 建筑师的图纸上，教室窗户下方有一套托宾式管道通风装置。

entries.en: The reading group compared two translations of Ovid before discussing their different tones.
entries.zh: 读书小组先比较了奥维德作品的两个译本，再讨论它们语气的差异。

entries.en: The debugger displayed the instruction address (IA) beside the paused instruction.
entries.zh: 调试器在暂停执行的那条指令旁边显示了指令地址。

entries.en: A Corsican designer helped the students choose fabric for their costumes.
entries.zh: 一位科西嘉设计师帮助学生们挑选戏服布料。

entries.meaningZh: 太阳神〔腓尼基神话称呼〕
entries.en: The illustrator drew Baal beside the sun in her imagined mythological scene.
entries.zh: 插画师在她构想的神话场景中，把太阳神画在太阳旁边。

entries.en: The Burundian beside me offered to help carry the boxes upstairs.
entries.zh: 我身旁的那位布隆迪人主动提出帮忙把箱子搬上楼。

entries.en: Mrs. Tussaud returned the empty jars after making room in her kitchen.
entries.zh: 图索太太在厨房腾出空间后，把那些空罐子还了回来。

entries.en: She recorded the story in Romany before making an English translation.
entries.zh: 她先用吉普赛语记录下那个故事，再作英语翻译。

entries.meaningZh: 贝灵翰姆〔美国华盛顿州地名〕
entries.en: The parcel sent from Bellingham, Washington, arrived with one corner torn.
entries.zh: 那个从华盛顿州贝灵翰姆寄来的包裹，寄到时有一角破了。

entries.en: A sketch of the Richelieu River hung beside the library's reading tables.
entries.zh: 一幅黎塞留河的速写挂在图书馆阅览桌旁。

entries.en: The historian examined accounts of opposition to the Ku Klux Klan.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家研究了关于反对三K党的记述。

entries.en: The class discussed Jack Kerouac after comparing the introductions to two biographies.
entries.zh: 全班比较了两本传记的导言后，讨论了杰克·凯鲁亚克。

entries.en: The printed programme included a short introduction to Giacomo Puccini for younger listeners.
entries.zh: 那份节目单中，有一段为年轻听众写的贾科莫·普契尼简介。

entries.en: They used a Linnaean classification scheme to organize the museum's specimen cards.
entries.zh: 他们利用林奈式分类方案整理博物馆的标本卡片。

entries.en: A Zoroastrian in the reading group volunteered to bring tea for everyone.
entries.zh: 读书小组里的一位索罗亚斯德教徒，自愿为大家带茶。

entries.en: The Shona sitting beside me offered to help hang the children's paintings.
entries.zh: 坐在我旁边的那位修纳人，主动提出帮忙挂孩子们的画。

entries.en: Seward found the missing glove beneath the bench in the entrance hall.
entries.zh: 苏华德在门厅长凳下面找到了不见的手套。

entries.en: She put a piece of Monterey Jack beside the sliced apples.
entries.zh: 她把一块蒙特里杰克干酪放在切好的苹果旁边。

entries.en: The student unfolded an old map of Judea beside her history notes.
entries.zh: 那个学生在历史笔记旁展开了一张朱迪亚旧地图。

entries.en: In the novel, he acts like a Galahad and refuses any reward.
entries.zh: 在那本小说中，他表现得像一位高洁之士，拒绝接受任何报酬。

entries.en: Cochran brought a small lamp to make the reading corner brighter.
entries.zh: 科克伦带来了一盏小灯，让阅读角更明亮。

entries.en: The students discussed Georges Bizet before choosing illustrations for their music project.
entries.zh: 学生们先讨论乔治·比才，再为音乐课题挑选插图。

entries.en: Bernhardt left a note explaining where the spare blankets were stored.
entries.zh: 伯恩哈特留了一张便条，说明备用毯子存放在哪里。

entries.en: Lemmon offered to water the plants while we were away.
entries.zh: 莱蒙主动提出在我们外出时替我们浇花。

entries.en: A Gurkha at the workshop helped the children build a cardboard theatre.
entries.zh: 工作坊里的一位廓尔喀人帮助孩子们搭建纸板剧场。

entries.en: The wooden ladder Mr. Weil returned had a fresh coat of paint.
entries.zh: 韦伊先生还回的木梯，新刷了一层漆。

entries.meaningZh: 蒙彼利埃〔美国佛蒙特州地名〕
entries.en: We found her address in Montpelier, Vermont, written inside the old notebook.
entries.zh: 我们在那本旧笔记本里，找到了她在佛蒙特州蒙彼利埃的地址。

entries.en: Mrs. Menuhin kept the guest-room key in a small wooden box.
entries.zh: 梅纽因太太把客房钥匙放在一个小木盒里。

entries.en: Meir borrowed a large bag to carry the books home from the library.
entries.zh: 迈尔借了一个大袋子，用来从图书馆带书回家。

entries.en: The old sketch of Mount McKinley had a tear along one edge.
entries.zh: 那幅麦金利山的旧速写，有一边撕破了。

entries.en: The drawings she made of the Kalahari Desert were stored beneath the travel journals.
entries.zh: 她画的那些喀拉哈里沙漠画作，存放在旅行日记下面。

entries.en: An Aleutian in the workshop helped us mount the exhibition photographs.
entries.zh: 工作坊里的一位阿留申人帮助我们装裱展览照片。

entries.en: The biography of Tiberius had handwritten comments on several of its pages.
entries.zh: 那本台比留传记有好几页写着手写批注。

entries.en: Weinberg brought a folding stool so that everyone could sit around the table.
entries.zh: 温伯格带来了一张折叠凳，让大家都能围着桌子坐下。

entries.en: The archivist compared two old portraits of Dwight Eisenhower, known as Ike.
entries.zh: 档案员比较了两张德怀特·艾森豪威尔的旧肖像；他以艾克这个昵称为人所知。

entries.en: The letter from Bannockburn included a drawing of the writer's new kitchen.
entries.zh: 那封从班诺克本寄来的信里，有一幅写信人的新厨房的画。

entries.en: She compared two editions of the Talmud before preparing her reading notes.
entries.zh: 她比较了《塔木德经》的两个版本，然后才整理阅读笔记。

entries.meaningZh: 萨拉托加〔纽约州村落旧名〕
entries.en: She unfolded an old map of the village formerly called Saratoga.
entries.zh: 她展开了一张旧地图，上面是那个旧称萨拉托加的村落。

entries.en: The old album contained a drawing of a quiet street in Smyrna.
entries.zh: 那本旧相册里，有一幅士麦那安静街道的画。

entries.en: The archivist sorted letters concerning the United States Air Force (USAF) into a separate folder.
entries.zh: 档案员把涉及美国空军的信件整理到一个单独的文件夹中。

entries.en: Plath remembered the spare towels but forgot to pack a toothbrush.
entries.zh: 普拉思记得带备用毛巾，却忘了把牙刷装进行李。

entries.en: A letter from Mandalay arrived while we were packing for another journey.
entries.zh: 我们正为另一次旅行收拾行李时，一封从曼德勒寄来的信到了。

entries.en: The map of Eurasia was too large to unfold on the small desk.
entries.zh: 那张欧亚大陆地图太大，无法在那张小书桌上展开。

entries.en: Her sketch of Lake Baikal was framed beside a photograph of her paternal grandparents.
entries.zh: 她那幅贝加尔湖速写装了框，摆在她祖父母的照片旁边。

entries.en: The researcher consulted a biography of James Paget while preparing the historical introduction.
entries.zh: 研究者在准备历史背景导言时，查阅了一本詹姆斯·佩吉特的传记。

entries.en: Kubrick carried the empty baskets into the shed before the rain began.
entries.zh: 开始下雨之前，库布里克把空篮子搬进了棚屋。

entries.meaningZh: 比尔博姆〔评论家、漫画家〕
entries.en: The students compared two portraits of Max Beerbohm for their illustrated presentation.
entries.zh: 学生们为配插图的展示报告，比较了两幅马克斯·比尔博姆的肖像。

entries.en: Mr. Smollett brought an extra blanket for the guest sleeping downstairs.
entries.zh: 斯莫利特先生给睡在楼下的客人带来了一条额外的毯子。

entries.en: Vitus found the empty flowerpots stacked behind the garden bench.
entries.zh: 维达斯发现那些空花盆叠放在花园长凳后面。

entries.en: The old photographs of Mycenae were packed beside the excavation notebooks.
entries.zh: 那些迈锡尼的旧照片，与考古发掘笔记本放在一起打包。

entries.meaningZh: 屋檐排水槽〔苏格兰用语〕
entries.en: Water spilled from the blocked rhone above the back door.
entries.zh: 水从后门上方堵塞的屋檐排水槽里溢了出来。

entries.en: The historian compared Lamarckian explanations in two old biology textbooks.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家比较了两本旧生物学教材中的拉马克学说解释。

entries.en: Mrs. Dreyfus offered to lend us a larger pot for the soup.
entries.zh: 德莱弗斯太太主动提出，借一个更大的锅给我们煮汤。

entries.en: The researcher found a letter from Wyeth among the old company papers.
entries.zh: 研究者在那些旧公司文件中，找到了一封惠氏公司的来信。

entries.en: A Manichaean in the historical novel asks permission to borrow a manuscript.
entries.zh: 那本历史小说中的一位摩尼教徒，请求获准借阅一份手稿。

entries.en: The seminar compared Calvinistic arguments in two historical theological texts.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了两篇历史神学文本中的加尔文主义论证。

entries.en: The parcel from Wilmington, Delaware, contained a small painting and several letters.
entries.zh: 那个从特拉华州威明顿寄来的包裹里，有一幅小画和几封信。

entries.en: The reviewer discussed the Proustian treatment of memory in the student's fictional scene.
entries.zh: 评论者讨论了那个学生的虚构场景中，对记忆的普鲁斯特式处理。

entries.en: The drawing of Mount Kilimanjaro was folded inside the artist's travel diary.
entries.zh: 那幅乞力马扎罗山的画，折好夹在画家的旅行日记里。

entries.meaningZh: 博林布鲁克〔英国历史国王称呼〕
entries.en: The students compared two portraits of Henry Bolingbroke for their history presentation.
entries.zh: 学生们为历史展示报告，比较了两幅亨利·博林布鲁克的肖像。

entries.en: Wollstonecraft brought spare paper for the children drawing at the kitchen table.
entries.zh: 沃斯通克拉夫特给在厨房桌旁画画的孩子们带来了备用纸张。

entries.en: A folded drawing of the Orinoco River lay beneath the travel books.
entries.zh: 一幅折好的奥里诺科河的画，放在旅行书籍下面。

entries.en: The sketch of the Magdalena River was damaged when the notebook got wet.
entries.zh: 笔记本被弄湿时，那幅马格达莱纳河的速写受了损。

entries.en: She ordered a Bellini and carried it carefully back to the table.
entries.zh: 她点了一杯贝里尼鸡尾酒，小心地端回桌旁。

entries.en: Seurat put the wet umbrella in a bucket beside the entrance.
entries.zh: 瑟拉把湿雨伞放进了入口旁的桶里。

entries.en: The lecturer discussed Botticelli while the students compared two exhibition catalogues.
entries.zh: 学生们比较两本展览图录时，讲师讨论了波提切利。

entries.en: Our letters from Windhoek arrived with the parcel of sketchbooks.
entries.zh: 那些从温得和克寄来的信，与装着速写本的包裹一起到了。

entries.meaningZh: 皮格马利翁〔希腊神话人物〕
entries.en: The illustrator made several drawings of Pygmalion for the new storybook.
entries.zh: 插画师为那本新故事书，画了好几幅皮格马利翁的画。

entries.en: Eisenstein carried the clean cups upstairs while we prepared the reading room.
entries.zh: 我们准备阅览室时，艾森斯坦把干净杯子搬上了楼。

entries.en: The researcher compared two biographies of John Burgoyne before writing her introduction.
entries.zh: 研究者在写导言之前，比较了两本约翰·伯戈因的传记。

entries.en: The Mohican in the workshop helped us arrange the children's drawings.
entries.zh: 工作坊里的那位马希坎人帮助我们摆放孩子们的画。

entries.en: Mrs. Vanbrugh left a folded towel on the chair beside the bed.
entries.zh: 范布勒太太在床边的椅子上放了一条折好的毛巾。

entries.en: A letter from Trondheim was waiting in the kitchen when we returned.
entries.zh: 我们回来时，一封从特隆赫姆寄来的信正放在厨房里。

entries.en: Smalley brought a folding chair so that nobody had to stand.
entries.zh: 斯莫利带来了一把折叠椅，这样就不必有人站着了。

entries.en: The old notebook from Malmo contained a drawing of the writer's room.
entries.zh: 那本来自马尔摩的旧笔记本里，有一幅笔记作者房间的画。

entries.en: We discussed Eugène Delacroix after comparing the introductions to two exhibition catalogues.
entries.zh: 比较了两本展览图录的导言后，我们讨论了欧仁·德拉克罗瓦。

entries.en: A Tyrolean musician lent us a music stand for the school rehearsal.
entries.zh: 一位提洛尔音乐家借给我们一个谱架，用于学校的排练。

entries.meaningZh: 卡拉布里亚〔意大利地区名〕
entries.en: Her notebook from Calabria had several loose drawings between its pages.
entries.zh: 她那本来自卡拉布里亚的笔记本里，夹着几幅散页画作。

entries.en: The translator compared two Slovakian versions of the story before recording her comments.
entries.zh: 译者先比较了那个故事的两个斯洛伐克语版本，再记录自己的评语。
